title: finding(console): `FormPage` renders a WORKING text input for the RETIRED `owner` field type — the tombstone that refuses it visibly everywhere else is bypassed by this renderer's own switch
body:
## The finding

objectui#4814 retired the `owner` field type, and the registry answers that key with a **tombstone that refuses visibly** — `resolveFormWidgetType('owner')` returns `owner`, measured at runtime against the built `@object-ui/fields`.

`apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` has **no `owner` arm**, so the retired spelling falls through its default arm and renders a **working `input type=text`**.

⇒ ⭐ that is precisely the silent degradation the tombstone exists to prevent. On the `/f/:slug` and `/forms/:name` routes an author who writes a retired field type gets a control that looks like it works, stores a value, and never says the type is gone — while every other renderer refuses it loudly.

## Why it is class (b) and not an opinion

The contract is declared and it is enforced **elsewhere in this same tree**: the tombstone is the declared answer for `owner`, and the shared resolver honours it. This renderer bypasses it by having its own switch. ⛔ Nothing here is about whether the retirement was right — only that one renderer does not implement it.

⭐ It is mechanically checkable **independently of** the wider 「two input switches」 consolidation question, which is why it is its own card: a pin asserting that a retired type does not render a working control needs no architectural decision first.

Seam: `spec:RETIRED_FIELD_TYPES.owner` → renderer `apps/console` `FormPage` `FieldInput` default arm. Consumer: the `/f/:slug` and `/forms/:name` routes.

## Provenance and radius

Measured by the dev on objectui#10167 while adding the `file` arm, ⛔ not re-derived by this seat. Radius: the runtime resolver answer plus the `FormPage` switch body at that branch's base. ⛔ Outside: whether any stored metadata actually still carries `owner` today — worth measuring before grading.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat #1 (`session_01Xr7APep6jm1Zta3KUzPzZf`) at ACCEPT of that card — devs do not file, seats do. ⛔ Filed bare.
